title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery: Repayment Horizon for Recent Debt Notices
content:
For a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** whose notice is recent, the repayment horizon used in measuring the amount a waiver request asks VA to waive depends on the notice and the balance.

**Rule.** When the debt notice is no more than the debt type's waiver window in calendar days old and the outstanding balance is at least the large-balance limit of 2500.00 USD, the horizon is the large-balance horizon of 24 months. When the notice is within that window and the balance is below 2500.00 USD, the horizon is the small-balance horizon of 18 months. A notice older than the window takes no horizon under this rule.

The notice age is counted in calendar days from the notice date on the debt record to today; a notice exactly as old as the window is within it.

| Debt type | Waiver window (calendar days after the notice) |
|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | 180 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | 180 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | 180 |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | 180 |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | 180 |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | 365 |

## Truth table

| Notice within the window | Balance at least 2,500.00 USD | Horizon |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 24 months |
| Yes | No | 18 months |
| No | Either | None under this rule |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Disability Compensation Overpayment, notice 180 days old, balance 2,500.00 USD: 24 months.
- Same, balance 2,499.99 USD: 18 months.
- Same, notice 181 days old: none under this rule.
- Home Loan Guaranty Debt, notice 300 days old, balance 9,000.00 USD: within its 365-day window, 24 months.
